entries.af531cd41e646980: Its business framework is 'Starting from customer voices, we aim to be a company that creates tomorrow for agriculture and living.' Centered on three elements—the agricultural ICT cloud 'Agrinet Advance' for greenhouse horticulture, 'Chokotto Rimokon,' which enables remote monitoring and operation of heaters, and the data integration platform 'Chabu-Dai'—it states that it will advance labor saving and sophistication at cultivation sites. In addition, as a response to a decarbonized society, it states that it is providing electricity-powered heat pumps and developing heaters that use fuels, heat sources and next-generation energy with lower CO2 emissions.
